MSBA will decide which submitted costs are eligible; the projection assumes none are, so the final result may be better.
The committee took votes on the prior minutes and the monthly invoices; the results were not audible in the recording.
MSBA's final review takes about 90 days after paperwork is submitted, and retainage is being reduced as the work nears completion.

why_it_matters: A town share below the earlier projection could mean less borrowing for the school project, which bears on future debt payments paid from the town budget, mostly taxes.
The final cost is not settled until MSBA finishes its eligibility review and audit, so the share could still change.
